Latin word

situs

situs, sita, situm

adjective (participle of sinō), with esse and a phrase of place

located, situated (with esse); situation, site (of a town, a house)

In this lexicon

  • be located

    the recommended word · classical · Liv. 30.24.9: in quō (sinū) sita Carthāgō est (Lewis & Short); Cic. Verr. 2.4.106: locus in mediā īnsulā situs (Lewis & Short); Traupman 120, 341

  • position

    also used · classical · Cic. Rep. 2.22: urbis (Lewis & Short); Caes. BG 7.36 (Lewis & Short)

  • situs interrētiālis: website

    modern

Examples

  • in quō (sinū) sita Carthāgō est

    on which (bay) Carthage liesLiv. 30.24.9 (Lewis & Short)

    In the entry for be located

  • Trīclīnium situm est inter culīnam et balneum.

    The dining room is between the kitchen and the bathroom.Traupman 120

    In the entry for be located
